tools.name: get_company_profile
tools.description: Identity of Captia Technology: legal entity, tax id, offices, contact, the five business units and declared areas of knowledge. Use it to answer who Captia is or what each unit does.

tools.name: get_glossary_term
tools.description: Definition of an industrial term from the Captia glossary (90 entries: protocols, OT/IT concepts, industrial AI, energy). Accepts a slug or a visible label. If there is no confident match it returns close suggestions instead of a wrong definition.

tools.name: search_knowledge
tools.description: Full-text search across published editorial resources (guides, comparisons and technical articles on industrial data, OT/IT integration, industrial AI and energy) and glossary terms. Returns canonical URLs.

tools.name: list_protocols
tools.description: The industrial protocols Captia Connect ingests from, with family and summary. Call it before compare_protocols to learn the valid slugs.

tools.name: compare_protocols
tools.description: Compare two or more industrial protocols side by side on family, summary, how Captia Connect ingests them, and target keywords. Note: it does not expose throughput or transport specs, which are not published as structured data.

tools.name: calculate_oee
tools.description: Compute Overall Equipment Effectiveness from shift data: availability, performance, quality and OEE. Same formula as the published calculator, so results always match the website. Returns warnings for inconsistent inputs instead of failing.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_glossary_term" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
